variants.hypothesis: A single vertical research-editorial narrative will reduce context switching while preserving the causal derivation.

comparisons.reason: A preserves one reader task and one causal path; B recreates equal-weight card competition and turns qualification statuses into a dashboard.
comparisons.evidence: Candidate A has one hero claim, one formula block and one vertical reasoning rail. Candidate B places two equal hero panels, four PASS/FAIL cards, and two treatment cards in repeated grids.
